Entry: The sun has set on this dusty town, casting long shadows across the dirt streets. My encounter with the bandit was brief but telling - I've been made aware of the dangers that lurk in every alleyway and hidden hollow. The only solace is the extra ammunition cartridge I retrieved from his corpse, a small comfort against the uncertainty that lies ahead.

What a day it has been! I've faced down that fierce wolf and emerged victorious, its fur now mine to claim. With my health still strong at 70 out of 100, I'm feeling mighty optimistic about the prospects ahead - who knows what other treasures this prairie holds? The medium hide is already proving useful in keeping me warm and dry as night begins to fall.

Well, well, well. Look who just got outsmarted by some two-bit saboteur. I'm not saying it was a cakewalk, but let's just say my health is still reeling from the excitement - 68/100, to be exact. At least I've got this lovely loaf of bread to console me, because, honestly, what's a little trauma without some decent carbs?

I can hardly believe what just happened. That looter was as sneaky as a rattlesnake and twice as deadly - I swear my heart is still racing from the close call! I managed to fend them off with my new tomahawk, but it's left me feeling jumpy and on edge... what if another one pops out of nowhere?

Well, well, well. Another day, another dust-filled hour spent sulking in this pitiful excuse for a town. I mean, seriously, what's the point of being a rough-riding adventurer if you can't even rustle up some decent trouble? Got myself a Winchester barrel today, but let's be real, it's not like I'm exactly overflowing with excitement about it.
